skill.name: emailworkflowskill
skill.description: Plans, audits, and documents email lifecycle workflows with trigger inventories, routing checks, collision audits, and approval gates for live changes.
skill.summary: Map and audit email workflows with clear routes, triggers, ownership, QA checks, and approval gates.
skill.author: Sequenzy

security_audit.summary: Static analysis found no suspicious patterns in this prompt-only skill. Manual review found no prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, or unsafe email automation behavior.

content.value_statement: Email automations can become hard to trace when triggers, exits, and owners are unclear. This skill maps routes and produces review-ready workflow guidance.
actual_capabilities: Creates text workflow maps with triggers, waits, branches, messages, exclusions, exits, and reporting checkpoints.
Inventories entry sources such as forms, product events, imports, webhooks, CRM stages, and manual enrollments.
Flags recipient collisions, duplicate flow entry, competing messages, and suppression bypass risks.
Defines sources of truth across product analytics, CRM, billing, support, and ESP data.
Produces handoff notes, collision audits, routing diffs, and operator-ready QA plans.
Separates analysis from live-system actions and requires approval before high-risk email changes.
limitations: Does not connect to ESPs, CRMs, analytics, or billing systems by itself.
Does not send email, import contacts, change DNS, or edit production automations.
Requires accurate workflow exports, event definitions, and ownership details from the user.
Does not replace legal review for consent, privacy, or regional email rules.

use_cases.title: Audit Lifecycle Routing
use_cases.description: Review an existing email lifecycle map for unclear triggers, missing exits, ownership gaps, and duplicate enrollment risks.

use_cases.title: Plan Sequence Handoffs
use_cases.description: Define how contacts move between marketing, sales, product, and support messages without conflicting automation paths.

use_cases.title: Prepare QA Notes
use_cases.description: Convert workflow plans into operator-ready QA checks before template edits, imports, or production automation changes.

prompt_templates.title: Map a Basic Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a first workflow outline.
prompt_templates.prompt: Map this email workflow in text. Include the trigger, eligibility, wait steps, messages, exclusions, exits, owner, and reporting checkpoints.

prompt_templates.title: Review Trigger Logic
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of automation entry and exit rules.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these trigger and suppression rules. Identify ambiguous source data, duplicate enrollment risks, missing exits, and approval questions before launch.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Handoff Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced coordination across teams and lifecycle stages.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a handoff plan for this lifecycle sequence. Show ownership, route boundaries, CRM or product data dependencies, QA checks, and escalation points.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Multi-Path Lifecycle
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced audit of overlapping lifecycle automations.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this multi-path email lifecycle. Produce a routing diff, collision risks, suppression checks, reporting checkpoints, and the smallest safe change set.

output_examples.input: Review an onboarding sequence that enrolls users from signup, trial activation, and CRM imports.
output_examples.output: The review highlights three entry sources, one duplicate enrollment risk, missing exits for paid users, and a QA checklist for suppression testing.

output_examples.input: Plan a recovery workflow for inactive customers who also have open support tickets.
output_examples.output: The plan separates recovery messages from support-owned contacts, names support status as the source of truth, and adds an exit for reopened accounts.

output_examples.input: Prepare operator notes for a template edit and segment import.
output_examples.output: The notes classify the work as medium risk, list required approvals, define import checks, and reserve live changes for explicit confirmation.

best_practices: Start by defining the workflow boundary and every entry source.
Name one source of truth for each routing decision.
Keep live sends, imports, DNS changes, and production automation edits behind explicit approval.
anti_patterns: Changing production automations before mapping triggers, exits, and suppression rules.
Using hidden intent or broad segments when explicit events or properties are available.
Measuring only opens and clicks while ignoring enrollment, branch split, drop-off, and conversion by path.

faq.question: What email work is this skill designed for?
faq.answer: It supports workflow maps, lifecycle routing, trigger reviews, handoff plans, collision audits, and QA notes for email operations.

faq.question: Can it make live changes in an email platform?
faq.answer: No. It produces plans and review artifacts, and it requires explicit approval before any live-system action.

faq.question: What inputs make the review more useful?
faq.answer: Provide workflow exports, trigger rules, lifecycle definitions, suppression rules, ownership details, and recent examples of routing problems.

faq.question: Does it help with compliance decisions?
faq.answer: It can surface consent and suppression checkpoints, but it does not replace legal review for email compliance.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: How does it handle high-risk email actions?
faq.answer: It treats live sends, contact imports, suppression edits, DNS changes, migrations, and destructive cleanup as approval-gated work.
